hooks.command: g=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --no-pager show refs/remotes/origin/main:tools/main_checkout_guard.py </dev/null 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$g" ] && exec python3 -I -c 'import sys; exec(compile(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], "exec"), {"__name__": "__main__", "__file__": sys.argv[2]})' "$g" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/main_checkout_guard.py"; test ! -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/main_checkout_guard.py" || exec python3 -I "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/main_checkout_guard.py"
